ModMetaData.name: Workbench Ingredients
ModMetaData.author: archdukejim
ModMetaData.description:
Configure where each work table pulls its crafting ingredients from — once, for the whole bench — instead of per bill.
Every work table gets an "Ingredient sources" button in its Bills tab. Open it and check any combination of stockpile zones, storage buildings (shelves/racks) and storage groups. The bench then draws ingredients from all of those sources combined, map-wide, and ignores each bill's own ingredient search radius.
If you leave every source unchecked, the bench instead uses a single per-bench fallback search radius (pre-filled from a global default in the mod settings), applied to every bill at that bench.
Only WHERE ingredients are searched changes. The ingredient filter, required amounts, allow-mixing rules, reachability and forbidden checks are all vanilla — this mod reuses the game's own ingredient matcher and only swaps the candidate set it searches.
IMPORTANT — keep this mod loaded while a save uses it. It attaches a small component to every work table def to store each bench's source selection. Removing the mod is safe (work tables simply lose their stored selection and revert to vanilla per-bill radius), but you will get one-time "could not load" warnings and every bench's configuration is discarded. Keep it enabled to preserve your per-bench setups.
Requires Harmony. Safe to add mid-save.
